name: tiny-text
description: A small JavaScript text library: four functions, each its own claim, built by agents at the same time.

assumptions.statement: Input text is plain ASCII, so no Unicode normalisation is needed.
The library runs on Node 22 or later, so ES modules and node:test are available.

claims.statement: src/slugify.js exports slugify(text): lower case, every run of characters other than letters and digits becomes a single hyphen, and there is no hyphen at either end. test/slugify.test.js covers it.

src/truncate.js exports truncate(text, max): the text unchanged if it has at most max characters; otherwise cut at the last space that fits and ended with "...", so the result has at most max characters. test/truncate.test.js covers it.
src/word-count.js exports wordCount(text): the number of words separated by whitespace, and 0 for an empty or blank string. test/word-count.test.js covers it.

src/unique-slug.js exports uniqueSlug(slug, taken): the slug itself if the Set taken does not contain it, otherwise the first of slug-2, slug-3, ... that it does not contain. It is meant to be called on slugify's output. test/unique-slug.test.js covers it.
